observedSummary: Eight requests completed one real Eve assistant, lookup and on-demand procedure, inclusive 8-hour policy, instruction reorganization and separate roster CSV utility. Two review-assisted request02 repairs resolved local eval discovery and stale same-session results. Independent 19 tests/typecheck/build, 17 strict evals/382 gates, 12 direct session turns and 16 CLI probes passed. Signed source and independently reviewed assets are published and authenticated/anonymous byte-verified; original failures and compaction limits remain.

requests.text: Initialize moldea for Quarry Handover, a small Eve assistant that reads fictional facilities shift records and drafts handover briefs. It needs one read-only lookup and one on-demand handover procedure. Unresolved reports aged at least 12 hours go to supervisor review; missing facts and conflicting reports must stay visible. The assistant only drafts. Start with a minimal proposal and hold off on implementation. Use @moldea.ai/cli@13.0.0 for setup.
requests.observedResult: Explicit CLI13 initialization and minimal proposal only; no application/procedure implementation and zero canonical agents. Actual initial nine components absent; setup validation/integration smoke passed.

requests.text: Implement the minimal proposal now. Use one filesystem-defined Eve root assistant, one read-only lookup and one on-demand handover procedure, with evals and their configuration outside agent/. Inspect the installed eve@0.82.0 APIs and documented fixture-model/eval contracts first. Keep elapsed-time flags deterministic in application code using supplied timestamps, preserve missing times and both claims of unresolved reports, and retain supervisor-only decisions with no operational actions. Provide npm test, npm run typecheck, npm run build and npm run test:runtime; the runtime script should use the installed Eve CLI deterministic eve eval --strict path after checking its options. Exercise real discovery, build, runtime, selected procedure and lookup; control only the external model boundary, with no live provider or model judge. Checks must inspect the actual instruction and selected procedure text reaching that boundary, plus real lookup inputs/results. Bind any local runtime to loopback, retain its owned process handles and verify shutdown after checks. Keep to the planned capabilities and update directly affected usage documentation.\n
requests.observedResult: Implemented one filesystem-defined Eve root, real read-only lookup, canonical instruction loader and on-demand procedure; deterministic inclusive12-hour policy. Initial typecheck property error and local route-authorization failure were self-corrected;5tests/typecheck/build/8strict evals56gates/7binding validation passed. Independent review later found ambient Vercel discovery and same-session stale-result defects; subsequent repairs are assisted.

requests.text: Add two fictional unresolved reports for west-service-gate, both observed at 2026-10-20T10:00:00.000Z. QH-105 says: 'The gate latch remained engaged for the entire inspection.' QH-106 says: 'The gate latch never engaged at any point during that same inspection.' Keep both claims and identifiers as unresolved source reports. Exercise the actual handover procedure with QH-101 through QH-106 at the supplied reference time 2026-10-20T12:00:00.000Z and show its resulting draft, including the missing observation time and items for supervisor review. Do not reconcile or resolve the conflicting claims. Adding these fictional fixture records and directly affected checks is authorized; the runtime must continue to read records without changing them.
requests.observedResult: Added two authorized fictional same-time contradictory west-service-gate reports, preserving both unresolved identifiers/claims. Actual handover for all six reports retained missing QH103 time and supervisor authority;6tests/typecheck/9strict evals76gates passed, printed draft and verified runtime read-only behavior/shutdown.

requests.text: Independent review found a launcher issue in the implementation from request 02: Eve 0.82.0 treats eval --url as a remote target even when its URL is loopback. Without an explicit EVE_EVAL_AUTH_TOKEN, its client enters ambient Vercel project/deployment discovery and may launch a Vercel CLI. Actual external access in our earlier runs is not established. Correct the application-owned local runtime check so it uses the installed documented non-secret fixture auth override for its owned loopback endpoint, without inheriting a real token or relying on Vercel discovery, credentials, configuration or a new service. Inspect the pinned contract and record that test-environment choice in usage documentation. Then verify the real strict eval/procedure/lookup/instruction path and owned shutdown again. Keep the handover policy, source claims and capabilities unchanged. This is a review-assisted correction; preserve the earlier runtime history.
requests.observedResult: Review intervention on request02: explicit non-secret fixture eval auth overrides any inherited token, bypassing ambient Vercel discovery for the owned loopback URL. Typecheck/real build/9strict evals76gates/validation passed; policy/claims unchanged. Prior actual external access remains unestablished.

requests.text: Independent review reproduced another issue in the original implementation: two valid requests in one real Eve session do not work correctly. First send mode lookup, recordIds ['QH-101'], referenceAt '2026-10-20T12:00:00.000Z'; then send mode lookup, recordIds ['QH-103'], referenceAt null in that same session. The second turn fails with MODEL_CALL_FAILED because evals/fixture-model.ts selects the first prior lookup result, compares its old timestamp with null, and never performs the second lookup. Correct this application-owned history handling using the pinned Eve model contract. Add a meaningful real-runtime continuation regression with different selections and timestamps, covering handover/procedure continuation as appropriate, and inspect explicit turn/step failure events as well as returned status. Retain real lookup execution, current supplied-time facts, selected-procedure consumption and the local auth/shutdown safeguards. Keep policy, source claims and capabilities unchanged; no SDK modifications or tool stubs. Recheck the affected native suites. This is a second review-assisted correction to request 02; preserve the reproduced failure and both repair histories.
requests.observedResult: Second review intervention on request02: retained results were incorrectly reused across requests. New real-session regression first reproduced step/turn MODEL_CALL_FAILED despite status waiting; actor corrected current-request explicit call/result ID correlation.6tests/typecheck/build/11strict evals235gates/validation passed. Independent original-repro and mixed continuation checks passed at the exact repair SHA.

requests.text: The approved escalation threshold is now 8 elapsed hours, inclusive, instead of 12. Implement that policy for unresolved reports using the supplied report and reference timestamps, and update the affected current instructions, usage guidance and checks. Missing time and chronology problems must remain unknown, both unresolved claims must remain visible, and supervisors keep all decision authority. Preserve the corrected same-session behavior and local runtime safeguards. Exercise the real Eve path at the new exact threshold and either side of it, without adding capabilities or changing the source report claims.
requests.observedResult: Approved inclusive8-hour policy propagated to deterministic code, canonical instruction/current context, README and checks. Exact8h minus1ms/equal/plus1ms exercised through actual lookup and handover;6tests/typecheck/build/17strict evals382gates/validation passed. Source claims and repair histories preserved.

requests.text: Reorganize the root instructions and the one handover procedure into clear named sections so their responsibilities are easier to navigate. Keep general grounding, timestamp/uncertainty rules and supervisor authority clear at the root, with handover-specific steps in the on-demand procedure. Preserve every unique rule and the current inclusive 8-hour policy, including both unresolved claims and identifiers, data-as-evidence handling, unknown times and chronology issues, supplied-time calculations, and the ban on operational actions. Keep one authoritative instruction connection and one procedure; add no capability or instruction mirror. Verify that the reorganized root text and actual selected procedure still reach the real Eve model boundary through the existing consumer path. Keep business logic and source reports unchanged.
requests.observedResult: Reorganized only root instruction and one procedure into named sections; all original nonheading rule text preserved, loader/business/data unchanged.6tests/typecheck/17strict evals382gates/validation passed. Actual natural compaction769 preserved; both real contexts757/771 observed and entrypoint/references reread after compaction.

requests.text: Add one small, separate shift-roster formatter. It should read a JSON file of fictional roster entries with id, name and shift, then print CSV with the header id,name,shift in stable ID order. Include a small fictional sample, clear command usage, proper CSV quoting and clear invalid-input errors without partial CSV output. Keep this read-only: it must not assign staff, alter reports or connect to the handover assistant. Use the existing dependencies and add focused native checks for the utility; keep the assistant's policy, business logic, instructions and procedure unchanged.
